problem.CONFIG_MONITORING_INVALID.title: Monitoring configuration is invalid
problem.CONFIG_MONITORING_INVALID.detail: The control service could not load its monitoring configuration. Ask an administrator to check the protected policy file and service logs, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_BUSY.title: Monitoring is busy
problem.MONITORING_BUSY.detail: All monitoring request slots are in use. Wait briefly, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Ask an administrator to correct the protected monitoring policy file and restart the control service, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRE: A readable protected monitoring policy file is required. Ask an administrator to configure it and restart the control service, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_OWNER_REQUIRED.title: Monitoring is unavailable
problem.MONITORING_OWNER_REQUIRED.detail: The control service could not initialize monitoring. Ask an administrator to check the service configuration and startup logs, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_HISTORY_RANGE_INVALID: The range is in the future, exceeds the configured maximum, or contains no settled evaluation point. Choose an earlier or shorter range and retry.
problem.MONITORING_HISTORY_RESPONSE_LIMI: The history result is too large
The result exceeds the history response limit. Choose a shorter time range and retry.
problem.MONITORING_HISTORY_NOT_CONFIGURE: No history stores are configured for this control service. Ask an administrator to configure fleet history and restart the service, then retry.
problem.MONITORING_LONG_TIER_NOT_CONFIGU: The selected range requires the long-term history store. Choose a recent range, or ask an administrator to configure that store and restart the control service.
The control service could not safely read the recent history store. Retry later. If the failure persists, ask an administrator to check the store, connectivity and configured trust.
problem.MONITORING_LONG_TIER_UNAVAILABLE: The control service could not safely read the long-term history store. Retry later. If the failure persists, ask an administrator to check the store, connectivity and configured trust.
problem.STORAGE_CANCELLED.title: The database request was cancelled
problem.STORAGE_CANCELLED.detail: The request ended before the database operation completed. Refresh the current state and try again.
problem.STORAGE_DEADLOCK.title: The database request needs another attempt
problem.STORAGE_DEADLOCK.detail: Concurrent operations conflicted in the database. Refresh the current state and retry. If the failure persists, ask an administrator to check database activity.
problem.STORAGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT.title: The database lock wait expired
problem.STORAGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT.detail: The database could not acquire a required lock in time. Wait briefly, refresh the current state and retry. If the failure persists, ask an administrator to check blocked transactions.
